Dual Light SlashBasic
Deals 2 stages of 80% ATK DMG each to a single enemy, with a 50% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns.
Countering EdgeActiveExclusive Lv.2
Grants self [Counterattack] for 3 turns. Meanwhile, grants self an additional 50% Effect Hit for 2 turns.
Light Spirit Blade Lv.2Elleena gains 1 more action turn and the duration of [Counterattack] is increased by 1 round after casting Countering Edge.
Spirit Blade ForcePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Elleena deals 35% ATK DMG to all enemies with 3 layers or more of [Bleed] and resets the duration of [Bleed] on them at the end of any ally's turn. Meanwhile, she grants herself 1 layer of [Spirit Blade]. Elleena casts Severing Light and loses all layers of [Spirit Blade] after reaching 8 layers of [Spirit Blade].
Light Spirit Blade Lv.1Additionally gains 30% Leech when Elleena has [Counterattack].
Light Spirit Blade Lv.3Spirit Blade Force is no longer limited to the number of [Bleed] layers. Meanwhile, there is a 100% chance to inflict a layer of [Bleed] on the target for 2 turns if the target is not under [Bleed] status when Spirit Blade Force deals DMG.
Severing LightActive
Deals 160% ATK DMG to all enemies, with a 70% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Bleed] for 2 turns. This skill has an additional 20% Leech.
